A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new approach for automatically bridging UML profiles to MOF metamodel.
we have developed a bridge that enables the use of profiled UML model in a DSML framework, and we have shown its feasibility and usefulness in a realistic case study.
we have developed an automatic bridge to transform SysML profiles into DSMLs, which can be used for model manipulation and model-to-model transformations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bridge is general enough to be reused for different profiles and DSMLs, thus reducing the effort needed to develop new bridges.
the proposed bridge allows designers to use UML profiles without any loss of expressivity.
UML profiles and domain specific modeling languages can be successfully combined, in order to get the advantages of both worlds.
